name: mdhub
long_description:
mdhub is the AI-native operating system for behavioral health. 

We combine AI workers with a purpose-built EHR, CRM, and RCM into one platform where clinical teams and AI collaborate across every workflow.

Mid to large-sized behavioral health clinics run on disconnected legacy systems that weren't designed for today's demand. The result: clinician burnout, admin bloat, and patients waiting weeks for care. mdhub replaces the entire fragmented stack with a single AI-first platform.

Our AI workers:

Emma, AI Clinical Assistant: automates documentation and gives clinicians back hours every day.
Sarah, AI Admissions Coordinator: handles 100% of inbound calls, verifies insurance, and books patients 24/7.
Eric, AI Billing Agent: manages coding, claims submission, and denial management same-day.

Our platform:

mdhub EHR: the first clinical workspace built for AI from day one. Documentation, intake, treatment planning, e-prescribing, and billing in one place.
mdhub CRM: every lead captured, every follow-up automated, nothing falls through the cracks.
mdhub RCM: end-to-end revenue cycle management. From claim submission to collections, AI-powered and fully integrated.

We're not another EHR with AI bolted on. We're not a point solution. We're the full operating system where AI workers and human teams run a clinic together. Hundreds of mid to large-sized behavioral health clinics use mdhub today, including some of the largest organizations in the country. One platform, less overhead, more patients seen.

launches.title: mdhub - AI native operating system for behavioral health clinics
launches.tagline: 🚀 mdhub just shipped the full stack.
launches.body:
**mdhub just shipped the full stack.**

We started mdhub with a simple belief: the biggest barrier to behavioral health care isn't the shortage of great clinicians. It's the broken infrastructure they're forced to work with.

Clinics run on five disconnected systems stitched together with duct tape. One for scheduling. One for documentation. One for billing. One for admissions. One for patient communication. None of them talk to each other. Clinicians waste hours every day navigating this mess instead of seeing patients.

Today, mdhub is the first AI-native operating system for behavioral health clinics. One platform where AI workers and clinical teams work together across admissions, clinical operations, and billing. Your AI workforce and AI-native EHR, in one

**Here's how we got here.**

Emma, our AI clinical assistant, has been used in over 3 million patient sessions across more than 1 million patients this past year. That's 500,000+ hours of admin work given back to clinicians. Hours they now spend seeing patients.

Sarah, our AI admissions coordinator, has booked over 100,000 patients into care. She handles 100% of inbound calls and texts for clinics, 24/7. She verifies insurance in real time, completes intake before the first appointment, and books patients in minutes, not days. Clinics using Sarah are booking 30% more new patients without adding a single person to their front desk. 

Eric, our AI billing agent, 10x billing teams, handling coding, claims submission, and denial management. Same-day claim submission. Higher accuracy than manual teams.

**Today we're launching three new products.**

**mdhub EHR**: a clinical workspace built from the ground up for AI, not retrofitted. Documentation, intake, treatment planning, e-prescribing, billing all in one place. 

**mdhub CRM**: admissions pipeline management where nothing falls through the cracks. Every lead was captured. Every follow-up is automated. First response time drops from 48 hours to 5 minutes. Clinics are converting 3x more leads without adding headcount. 

**mdhub RCM**: end-to-end revenue cycle management. From claim submission to collections, AI-powered and fully integrated.

**Why this matters:**

Behavioral health clinics can now run admissions, clinical operations, and billing in one place where their human team and AI workers collaborate across every workflow. No more logging into five systems. No more data falling between the cracks. No more choosing between an EHR that can't do billing and a billing tool that can't do clinical work. One platform that lets clinics scale with AI workers and an AI-native OS, not more headcount.

One platform. Human teams and AI workers, working together.

mdhub. Better operations. Elevated care.

👉[Book a demo](https://calendly.com/liza-mdhub/30min).

launches.title: mdhub - AI agents for mental health clinics
launches.tagline: We’re building AI agents to power the next generation of healthcare clinics - starting with mental health.
launches.body:
**tl;dr**

Today, we’re excited to introduce Sarah, our 24/7 AI Admissions Coordinator.

Sarah qualifies new leads and books intakes automatically, helping clinics boost new patient volume by up to 30%. She manages 100% of inbound calls - handling follow-ups, reschedules, and medication refill requests - ensuring no message ever falls through the cracks.

With Sarah, clinics stay responsive and scalable - no extra hires, no added overhead.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_9O_z1MqhCQ

**Our Journey**

We’re Dominik and Efren, on a mission to make mental healthcare accessible and affordable for everyone, everywhere. We met in 2018 while scaling a hyperscale startup - Efren as a founding engineer, and Dom as the first operator after starting his career at BCG. Since then, we’ve been building together, driven by a shared belief that AI and data will radically improve how patient care is delivered.

**The Problem**

Nearly 50 million Americans live with a mental health condition and that number grows by 1.5 million each year. Meanwhile, the U.S. is facing a growing shortage of 30,000 mental health clinicians, making it harder to meet rising demand.

But the real crisis isn’t just the clinician shortage - it’s that the antiquated, fragmented systems around them can’t keep up.

Even when providers are available, clinics struggle to manage the load. Intake calls go unanswered. Reschedules and refill requests fall through the cracks. Front desk staff are buried under hundreds of voicemails, forms, and follow-ups every week. Clinicians themselves spend more than half their time on documentation and admin, not with patients.

This operational drag is a massive bottleneck. Patients wait weeks for care, staff burn out, and clinics lose revenue on missed appointments and delayed treatment.

The result is a fragmented system that costs the U.S. healthcare system $300 billion annually due to delayed treatment, poor access, and administrative inefficiencies.

**The Solution**

One year ago, we launched our AI Clinical Assistant to help clinicians reclaim their time by automating clinical documentation, pre-charting, and treatment planning. It's now been used in over 1 million patient sessions.

Now we’ve launched Sarah, our AI Admissions Coordinator, to help patients access care faster by eliminating missed calls, delays, and administrative friction.

Sarah answers every call instantly, 24/7, no voicemails, no hold music. She qualifies new patients and books intakes, while also managing reschedules, cancellations, med refill requests, and appointment confirmations for existing patients.

Clinics using Sarah have seen up to a 30% increase in new patient bookings, while ensuring that 100% of existing patient inquiries are handled, without adding headcount.

**The Future We Are Building**

We believe the future of care will be driven by AI-first teams, where clinicians are surrounded by AI agents that handle everything outside the session, so they can focus on what matters most: seeing patients.

But we’re not just building the agents, we’re building the workspace where they collaborate, hand off tasks, and get things done.

**How You Can Help**

If you run, work at, or know someone at a mental health clinic, we’d love to connect.

You can reach us at [founders@mdhub.ai](mailto:founders@mdhub.ai), or you can book a demo on our [website](https://www.mdhub.ai/ai-intake-coordinator?utm_source=YC+Launch+2025&utm_medium=YC+Launch+2025&utm_campaign=YC+Launch+2025&utm_id=YC+Launch+2025).

launches.title: mdhub - Clinical AI assistant for mental health clinics
launches.tagline: We power mental health clinics with our AI assistants to efficiently run their operations.
launches.body:
# tl;dr

Instead of seeing patients, mental health clinicians spend 50% of their time on other tasks, delaying access to mental health care. We aim to help them become 10x more efficient with our clinical AI assistant by automating tasks that keep them from seeing more patients.

Since our launch 6 months ago, we successfully saved clinicians more than 100,000 hours in admin tasks, enabling them to generate tens of millions in additional revenue.

# Our Story

We are [Dominik](https://www.linkedin.com/in/dominik-middelmann-01232378/) and [Efren,](https://www.linkedin.com/in/efrenal/) and we are on a mission to make mental healthcare accessible and affordable for everyone, everywhere. Efren holds an MSc in Computer Science and has been passionate about leveraging technology to improve health outcomes and has extensive experience building products. Dom holds a Masters in Management from London Business School and started his career at BCG.

Our joint journey started in 2018 at a hyperscale start-up, where Efren joined as a founding engineer and Dom as the first hands-on operator. Since then, we have been building products together. As mental health challenges rise globally, we're committed to being at the forefront of innovation, leveraging AI and data to improve lives and transform care.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=82215&key=user_uploads/1803359/0efac628-16d5-4d3a-9d1c-5e6ca1d672d6)


# The Problem

Mental health issues are a growing concern in America, with approximately 50 million Americans currently grappling with a mental health condition. Alarmingly, this number is increasing by 1.5 million each year.

Concurrently, the US is on track to face a shortfall of 30,000 mental health clinicians by 2024, a situation that's already costing the US health system $300 billion annually due to delayed treatment.

In a world where time is of the essence, clinicians are spending only 50% of their day with patients, while the rest is consumed by tasks like clinical documentation, dealing with insurance, and other back-office heavy work.

# Our Solution

We power mental health clinicians with mdhub’s clinical AI assistant, enabling them to focus on patient care.

The patient-clinician conversation is at the core of mental health treatment, and by capturing it, our clinical AI assistant can automate tasks that prevent clinicians from dedicating more time to patients, such as writing clinical documentation, drafting patient after-visit reports, pre-charting, and treatment planning.

We are particularly excited about receiving daily appreciation from our users.

“…I absolutely love the software.” Female, Psychotherapist, Montana.

“…You have a dynamite product. I am so happy I came across you guys.” Female, Psychotherapist, Nevada.

“…Instead of an hour of paperwork at the end of the day I’m wrestling with my kids, well worth it!” Male, Psychiatrist, Minnesota.

“…It is truly such a great help - I am currently actually near burnout and going down on FTE for this year because of notes, and your program has given me some hope, actually!” Male, Psychiatrist, Texas.

# The Future We Are Building

We believe running a more efficient practice is just the first step. In the future we are building, we will empower clinicians to start and grow their practices, bringing us closer to our mission of making mental health accessible and affordable for everyone and everywhere.

# How you can help

If you own, work for, or know someone at a mental health clinic, we’d love to connect.

If you work for a behavioral health insurance company or know someone who does, please contact us.

You can reach us at [founders@mdhub.ai,](mailto:founders@mdhub.ai) or you can book a demo on our [website](https://bit.ly/4f6kvWn).
